name: Wind — Buffeting
_doc: Heavy low-band wind, like wind hitting a building corner or a car driving with a window cracked. Primary purpose: mask broadband sub-200-Hz rumble (HVAC, distant traffic, aircraft pass-overs) without the user perceiving water sounds.
_pairs_with: Broadband, low-fundamental noise. Recommender picks this in place of RainRumble when the user prefers wind to water.

layers.name: rumble_body
layers._doc: Brown noise 30-400 Hz, heavy — the masking workhorse here. Higher gain than forest_quiet's rumble_floor because broadband rumble needs more energy to mask.

layers.name: buffet_overlay
layers._doc: Mid-band wind (300-3000 Hz) layered for spectral coverage. Quieter than the rumble body — provides the 'wind character' on top of the heavy low end without dominating.

states.name: gusts
states._doc: Slightly more buffet_overlay, suggesting wind catching the building. Subtle — the perceived loudness shouldn't change much, just texture.

description: Gusty, broadband wind for masking traffic, HVAC or office chatter.
